title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Asalamualaykum mufti sahab,, I saw this dream twice, i saw that my father has passed away can you please tell what does it means?? 1416 views Q. What is the meaning of "Maulana"? To whom can we call "Maulan"? 2460 views Q. I am an employee of autonomous body and very busy with my job. I am living in developing new residential area since last 10 years. As per requirement the construction of a new masjid became necessary in our locality. For which a committe was formed and I become an office bearer of the masjid committee. I involve myself only for the cause of that all the constuction work of the masjid should be done as per the shari'a i.e. avoiding haram funds and materials. As I am very busy with my job and I offer daily five salat anywhere or in the house if the jama'at times over. Since I am not punctual to attend that local masjid to offer all five salat, hence some musalliyan are blaming me for the "khokli seerat" and say that "ta'ajjub hai aap ghar per namaz pade aur masjid doosron ke liye banaye". On continuous blaming by the musalliyan, now I want to leave membership from the masjid committee. Whereas 40% work of the constuction is remain to complete. And no other member look after the work carefully and maintain the shara'i oosool. May I leave this as majority of muslliyan dislike me? Please guide me what should I do? 2107 views Q. As Salaamu Alaikum. I had a dream and would like to have it interpreted Insha Allah. I was in a house with about 5 other people both male and female, I don't think any were Muslim except for me. Something broke and 2 went to the basement to fix it, while down there, the house exploded and everyone died. In my dream we were re-created and taken back to the time before the explosion without clear memory of what was to happen. We were reading a book with stories and it became clear to me that the book was reminding me what was going to happen. I knew it was the Will of Allah SWT so I didn't fight it or try to convince other people. Instead, when I recognised the time approaching for the explosion I rushed to make wudhu & make salah as I wanted to die in a state of salah. At the time of the explosion, nothing happened. I finished my prayer and went to see the other people. One man who had gone downstairs to fix the problem(as in the beginning) smiled at me and showed me his hand which was burnt. Can you please tell me what this means? May Allah SWT reward you for your time and effort. 1609 views Q. I saw hazrat Mohammed sallalahu alaihi wasallam two time in a dream and He (puh) was pleased. But third time I saw hazrat Mohammed(puh) with angry face and left. I read in the hadith that If hazrat Mohammed (puh) is not satisfy with anyone his ibaada goes in vien. So what will be happend to me before and after death and What I should do. Please advise me. 1519 views Q. Few Question for Clarification in Islamic way. Kindly advice me. 2) I would like to know that oral Sex and anal Sex is allowed in Islam or it is Haram. I understand that many People Now a days prefer this. 3) we are In Chennai & found that Here Muslim People Says That Buffalo Qurbani is Not valid and Goat They do not perform Badthi. Please confirm it is o.k as per islamic Law. I will look forward for your reply. 4922 views Q. Asalamu 'alaikum, Firstly, jazak Allah for all of the questions you have answered for me. I want to remove the thought of this dream that I had a few weeks ago. At sunrise time, I went to sleep and I had this dream- before I went to sleep, I think I made du'a to Allah and said the shahadah before sleeping. I also think I had started writing a hamd (poem) and the night before I had finished, al hamdu lillah, a hamd on Asma ul husna. So I dreamt of 4 particular things. I don't know the order, but I remember seeing a lecturer talk about something to do with Islam, then all of the sudden I looked out of the window to see a beautiful scene of snow in my garden with the orangy-red night sky. Then I remember being on my prayer mat, facing the qiblah and making du'aa unto Allah. I remember supplicating Ya Mu'min (WAllahu 'alam) and I then saw a tree next to me (it was black and I think it had no leaves), it seemed like it was doing ruku' (WAllahu 'alam) and coming towards me, I kept on moving my head away and was still doing the du'aa. I woke up still mumbling the du'a. What could this mean? Jazak Allahu Khair for your continued patience. Ma' salam. 1856 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 44392 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: azaan, hadees, naat, dua, quran ayat as caller tone Question: I read the fatwa about not to keep azaan, hadees, naat, dua, quran ayat as ringtone just want to clarify whether the same ruling is for caller tone also? Answer ID: 44392 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 429/390/N=1434) Yes, caller tone also has the same ruling as ringtones. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
